🛂 Immigration
MI HB 6158 — Michigan Limits Federal Access to State Buildings

Michigan is now blocking state and local governments from letting federal immigration officers into private areas without a court order. This new law clarifies that access is only allowed if a judge signs off, protecting spaces like offices and records rooms. .. .... ..
